thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High tail latency for customer MapleSky (single-tenant). p95 ok, p99 jumped from ~220ms -> ~3.2s for streaming completions across region us-west-2. Triggered SLO alert and customer page.
Riley (oncall): ACK. Joining. Any immediate customer impact reported?
Priya - Support: MapleSky ops reported UI stalls around 12:03 UTC, some users see partial streams freeze then resume. They've pasted a short log with stalled chunk ids.
Aisha K: I'm pulling traces now. Early signal: KV cache eviction spikes + unusually long prompt prefixes with emoji and base64 blobs from MapleSky's recent experiment. Might be degenerate prefix matching causing cache churn.
Marco L: Running query on runtime metrics: `rwctl query --range 10m --customer maplesky --metric latency.percentile 99` shows p99 spike correlated with increased session concurrency and a handful of long-running streaming sessions.
Tom S (runtime): I see sustained io_wait on the model server for a subset of sessions. Also repeated small token flushes causing context re-attach overhead. Could be prefix fanout + small chunk sizes.
Riley (oncall): Can we identify a signature prompt or example to reproduce? If it's long prefixes with embedded blobs, that might bypass prefix dedupe.
maplesky-bot: Sharing example prompt (sanitized): `START<user_blob>ffab...==</user_blob> ask: summarize with emojis 🙂🙂` — they said this pattern ramped after a deployment on their side.
Aisha K: That pattern will blow past our prefix canonicalization, yielding many unique KV keys. I'm seeing KV cache miss rate jump from 2% -> 48% for the tenant. Evictions spike at the same time window.
Marco L: Mitigation options: 1) Temporary routing of MapleSky to a more conservative model variant with larger KV capacity, 2) Rate-limit concurrent streaming sessions for that tenant, 3) Serve a short-lived fallback that disables prefix caching for affected sessions.
Priya - Support: MapleSky asked for ETA and asked to avoid a full restart. They prefer a quick mitigation to stop user-visible stalls.
Riley (oncall): Let's do stepwise: (A) apply tenant-level concurrency cap: `rwctl tenant update maplesky --stream-concurrency 25` to blunt the fanout. (B) route new sessions to `gptx-medium-kvcache` variant. Anyone object?
Tom S (runtime): Agreed. I'll deploy a route override. Applying now.
Tom S (runtime): `deploy route-override --tenant maplesky --model gptx-medium-kvcache --sticky 15m` -> done.
Marco L: Concurrency cap command applied -> `ok` from admission.
Riley (oncall): Observing metrics... p99 dropping from 3.2s -> ~700ms in 90s. Streaming stalls reduce.
Priya - Support: MapleSky reports UX improvement, partial streams resuming quicker. They still see rare stalls on very long blobs but much reduced. :thumbsup:
Aisha K: We should capture a sample workload and add a synthetic unit to evals for this tenant. Also propose to add a canonicalization rule for base64-like blobs to avoid KV explosion.
Marco L: Logged follow-up action: backend change to canonicalize `user_blob` tokens and add tenant-level cache guardrails.
Riley (oncall): Assigning postmortem: Aisha + Marco + Tom. Priya to own customer comms. Incident severity: Sev3 (customer-facing but mitigated).
maplesky-bot: Thank you team — MapleSky ops will hold on their deployment and share a sanitized example for engineers.
Riley (oncall): Notes to include in postmortem: timeline of p99 spike, KV miss/eviction graphs, routing override timestamps, concurrency cap, and customer impact estimate.
Aisha K: Quick data: affected requests ~6.2% of MapleSky traffic during spike window, 87% of stalls attributed to top-5 session prefixes.
Tom S (runtime): I'll keep the route override active for 30m and monitor. If stable, we'll rollback the override and instead push canonicalization in next sprint.
Riley (oncall): Thanks all. Closing on-call handoff in 10m unless we see regression. Adding `postmortem/assign` label. :white_check_mark:
